blurb: Island Packers offers boat transportation and tours to the Channel Islands National Park. Guests can take non-landing wildlife cruises, whale watching trips, birding excursions, or travel to various islands for day visits or camping. Trips include opportunities to see marine life, seabirds, and unique island species.

quotes.text: The cruise out to the Channel Islands is part of the experience. I’ve been using Island Packers Cruises for over 5 years now and I still get excited to get on the boats! The crew is fantastic and the captain will help you see wildlife and accompany the sighting with fun facts. I’ve taken people with sea sickness issues out to Scorpion on Santa Cruz with no issues on calm days, the crew also lets everyone know how to manage sea sickness. Always a pleasure to be on these boats, I make sure to tip the crew in cash at the end!

We had an absolutely incredible time on our trip out to Santa Cruz Island. Everything was seamless. Best of all, we were accompanied by hundreds of dolphins on our way out and back! It was awe-inspiring! Our hike around the island was equally fabulous, with incredible panoramic views of the ocean. This trip exceeded any expectations we had. Highly recommend!

I never expected the ferry ride to Santa Cruz Island to add so much to our experience of the Channel Islands NP! The captain and crew cared deeply about passengers seeing some of the amazing sea life in the channel, and were extremely knowledgeable about it. They also modeled excellent environmental conciousness , which we very much appreciated.

From reservations to the actual ferry crossing the folks that work at Island Packers made the whole experience seamless. The rates were reasonable. The ferry captain kept us to a schedule, but also allowed for some sightseeing of dolphins and whales. The crew was extremely helpful. Highly recommend!!

We loved our day at Santa Cruz Island and our transportation with Island packers. They are organized, informative and went above and beyond to add whale watching to our trip! All crew was helpful and friendly. Will use them again for sure.
Fantastic experience. Crew was timely, and very nice through the entire trip. Boat was well kept and comfortable. Even got to see a bunch of dolphins and whales on our way out to the Islands.
